creative-technologist.title: Creative Technologist
creative-technologist.summary: Creative technologist and hands-on creative lead with 20+ years across design, media and technology. Lead Designer at UNCX Network since December 2021, spanning brand, product interfaces, 3D and motion. I develop concepts into finished work: generative image/video and audio production in ComfyUI, complete brand films, reusable production systems and React-based prototypes. My practice connects art direction and storytelling with the technical judgement needed to make the work hold together.

design-engineer.title: Design Engineer
design-engineer.summary: Designer and hands-on builder combining product and interaction design with React, TypeScript and full-stack personal projects. Lead Designer at UNCX Network since December 2021, with 20+ years across design and technology. I turn complex requirements into user flows, reusable components and working interfaces, using AI-assisted development, scoped implementation and verification. Background in 3D and motion brings an additional focus on visual craft and interaction detail.

product-designer.title: Product Designer
product-designer.summary: Product designer with deep technical and creative-production fluency. Lead Designer at UNCX Network since December 2021, designing product flows, interfaces, design systems and educational experiences. I combine user experience and visual design with hands-on React prototyping and first-hand generative video and audio production. Comfortable moving from ambiguous requirements to implementation detail, collaborating with engineers and creative partners.

experience.title: Lead Designer

Designed wireframes and UI concepts for 10+ applications, with 3-4 shipped to production; mapped unfamiliar token-tool and Telegram workflows in FigJam and Figma.

Directed and produced Quiver brand films from a loose brief, covering script, art direction, generative imagery/video, animation, editing and AI-generated music using ChatGPT, ComfyUI and After Effects.
Led the 2022 name and logo rebrand. For the 2024 rebrand, briefed an external team on the foundations, then completed content, layouts and graphics across 10+ website pages.
Produced 200+ videos at UNCX using reusable Cinema 4D scenes, Redshift materials and After Effects templates for launches, tutorials and explainers.
Directed and completed UNCX Academy page designs and visuals, working from externally designed brand foundations with an in-house developer; produced 30+ educational videos.
